title: Lightly Luscious French Grass Tarte Tatin
description: A unique twist on the classic French dessert, featuring light rum, ssam-wrap, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients to help cure that hangover.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Place the ssam-wrap pastry on top of the dough, forming a square shape.
In a separate bowl, mix together the grass-fed coconut milk, light rum, coconut sugar, and butter.
Pour the coconut milk mixture into the ssam-wrap pastry-lined dough.
Crumble the grass-fed cream cheese on top of the coconut milk mixture.
Fold the edges of the pastry dough over the filling, creating a neat and tidy square shape.
Bake the tart in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Allow the tart to cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves and serve immediately.
